description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pelapitigama, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510214
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and title classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it a clear example of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
